title: Sr. HR Recruiter
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Recruiter with hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment. The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment cycle, coordinating with department heads, maintaining recruitment records, and supporting day\-to\-day HR activities.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

\- Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process from sourcing to joining.

\- Understand manpower requirements and prepare job descriptions in coordination with department heads.

\- Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, and other recruitment channels.

\- Screen and shortlist CVs based on job requirements.

\- Conduct initial HR screening/interviews and coordinate technical interviews.

\- Schedule interviews and maintain regular communication and follow\-up with candidates.

\- Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.

\- Coordinate offer discussions, offer letters, and joining formalities.

\- Ensure proper candidate documentation and onboarding coordination.

\- Build and maintain a talent pipeline for current and future requirements.

HR Operations \& Administration

\- Maintain employee records and HR documentation.

\- Support attendance, leave, and employee data management.

\- Assist with onboarding, confirmation, probation, and employee lifecycle processes.

\- Prepare HR reports and recruitment status updates for management.

\- Handle other HR and administrative responsibilities assigned by management.

Required Qualifications

\- MBA in Human Resources / HR Specialization preferred.

\- 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.

\- Experience in recruiting for multiple departments and job levels.

\- Strong knowledge of sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and candidate follow\-up.

\- Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, email, and recruitment platforms.

\- Strong coordination, follow\-up, documentation, and organizational skills.

\- Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.

Key Competencies

\- End\-to\-end recruitment

\- Candidate sourcing \& screening

\- Interview coordination

\- Communication \& negotiation

\- Candidate relationship management

\- Follow\-up \& coordination

\- Documentation \& reporting

\- Time management

\- Confidentiality and professionalism

\- Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from sourcing, screening, conducting initial interviews, offer negotiation and onboarding coordination.
* Work closely with department managers to understand role requirements and shape hiring strategy.
* Source candidates via Naukri, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Conduct structured candidate interviews to assess suitability, expectations and availability.
* Handle hiring across both IT and Non\-IT roles, spanning multiple departments.
* Manage salary and offer discussions within approved ranges and support successful offer closure.
* Ensure timely candidate follow\-up throughout the recruitment process.
* Keep candidate data accurate and up to date in the ATS.
* Track recruitment progress and provide regular updates to the relevant stakeholders.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support current and future hiring needs.
* Support other recruitment and related organisational tasks when required.

### **Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant recruitment experience. Proven track record in both IT and Non\-IT recruitment.
* Strong interviewing skills and the ability to assess candidate suitability.
* Ability to understand technical role requirements and evaluate the relevance of a candidate’s experience.
* Strong working knowledge of sourcing tools such as Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms.
* Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms.
* Strong ownership, organisation, attention to detail and follow\-up skills.
* Flexibility to take on related responsibilities based on organisational requirements.
* Willingness to follow a hybrid work model with 10 mandatory office days per month.
